author: Zelda Savage
content: Really delighted with the equipment and service from Dancing Cubs! We had the 2m x 2m Nature’s Own Pond ball pit with slide for my daughter’s 5th birthday, and it was a huge hit with the all the kids! They loved jumping in it and burying themselves under all the balls, as it’s so deep so quite different from a standard ball pit. Also the service on booking was great, so easy, and both delivery and collection were bang on time, and really helpful. Overall a great experience, highly recommended!
